heading_en: Standards for Approval of the Special Exclusion from Calculation of the BI
summary_ja: BIの算出に係る除外特例を承認する際の二つの審査基準を定める。
summary_en: Sets two standards the Commissioner applies in approving the special exclusion from the BI calculation.
paragraphs: When the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency intends to grant the approval under Article 292, the Commissioner shall examine whether all of the following standards are met. (i) That the consolidated subsidiary corporation, etc. or business unit for which the special exclusion under the provisions of Article 292 is sought has been disposed of. (ii) That it does not currently conduct, and does not plan to conduct in the future, business similar to that of the consolidated subsidiary corporation, etc. or business unit in the preceding item.
